title: Green Brick Brands and Professionals Earn Eight Honors at 2026 McSAM Awards
summary: Celebrating Excellence in Sales, Marketing, and Home Design Green Brick Partners, Inc. (NYSE: GRBK) is proud to announce that its homebuilding brands—CB JENI Homes, Normandy Homes, and Southgate Homes—earned eight honors at the 2026 McSAM Awards. The Bella II - Normandy Homes at Painted Tree Woodland North Presented annually by the Dallas Builders Association, the McSAM Awards honor excellence in sales, marketing, and residential design across the Dallas Metroplex.
